clue.text: Doctor doesn't start working out inspirational woman

indicators.note: the synonym for the doctoring verb loses its opening letter

parts.note: to doctor an animal is to neuter it
PE is physical education, a workout at school

explanation.surface: A medic who can't get going at the gym, beside an inspiring female figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' is a verb here, as a vet doctors a cat; 'doesn't start' drops the first letter of NEUTER to leave EUTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Euterpe is one of the nine Muses, the goddesses who inspire artists, so she is literally an inspirational woman.

clue.text: Rustic forbidden to appear in a French church

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: the forbidden word shows up inside the church letters

parts.note: out means not allowed

explanation.surface: A country bumpkin is banned from a French church.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustic can mean rough and unpolished, lacking refined manners.

clue.text: A long time to muse

parts.note: an era is a long period

explanation.surface: A long time to ponder something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'muse' looks like the verb ponder; it is the noun for a goddess of the arts.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is one of the nine Muses, presiding over love poetry.

clue.text: Favourite city medic's future wool supplier

parts.note: a pet is a favourite
LA, Los Angeles
MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A beloved city doctor's next source of wool.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet lamb is a young hand-reared sheep, which will grow into a fleece bearer.

clue.text: Order press to cover key letter from Plato

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit

indicators.note: the pressing word goes over and around the key

parts.note: to press clothes is to iron them
C is a musical key

explanation.surface: An instruction to press something down over a key, alongside a letter written by the philosopher Plato.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter from Plato' suggests his correspondence; it means a letter of the alphabet he would have used.
explanation.definitionFit: Omicron is a letter of the Greek alphabet, the one Plato wrote in.

clue.text: Coach amused stinging swimmer, one of 21

indicators.note: to coach is to train, reshaping the letters

explanation.surface: A trainer laughed at a jellyfish.
explanation.walkthrough: Two senses: a medusa is a jellyfish, and Medusa is one of the Gorgons at 21 down.
explanation.definitionFit: Zoologists call a free-swimming jellyfish form a medusa; myth's Medusa was the mortal Gorgon.

clue.text: Grow crop, last of rye bordering vital ground

indicators.note: the crop word and the last letter go around the other letters

parts.note: to crop is to cut

indicators.note: the final letter of the word
ground means milled or crushed, reworking the letters

explanation.surface: Raise crops, the last of the rye edging some essential land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' is the anagram signal, as in coffee ground, not land; 'Grow' is a transitive verb, as in growing a crop.
explanation.definitionFit: To cultivate plants is to grow them.

clue.text: Open University book inspires college sequel

parts.note: OU, the UK distance-learning university

indicators.note: breathes in, so the book takes the college letter inside

parts.note: a tome is a large book

explanation.surface: An Open University textbook motivates a college follow-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A sequel can mean a result or consequence, what follows from an event.

clue.text: High priest of soul maybe told about dancing

indicators.note: high means intoxicated, so the letters are scrambled
spoken rather than written, the sound alone is used

parts.note: soul sounds like Seoul, so of Seoul may be Korean

explanation.surface: A soul singer's top priest is reported on dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soul' suggests Seoul, giving KOREAN, which 'told' turns into CHOREAN. 'High' scrambles PRIEST to TERPSI.
explanation.definitionFit: Terpsichorean means relating to dance, from Terpsichore, the Muse of dancing.

clue.text: Periodically fancy that series of old deeds

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals, every second one of the phrase

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at a run of historic documents.
explanation.definitionFit: Acta are recorded proceedings or transactions, a Latin term for a body of official records of acts done.

clue.text: Roosevelt settled for Republican surveying device

indicators.note: one word stands in place of the party initial in the president's first name

parts.note: Theodore Roosevelt, the US president
a bird that settled has lit on a perch

explanation.surface: President Roosevelt chose a Republican device for land surveys, fittingly since he was one.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the R of THEODORE for LIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A theodolite is the tripod-mounted instrument surveyors use to measure angles.

clue.text: Cretan king's mother's contribution to neuropathology

indicators.note: the letters are a part given by the longer word, sitting inside it

explanation.surface: The mother of a king of Crete made a contribution to the study of nerve disease.
explanation.walkthrough: In myth Europa, carried off by Zeus as a bull, bore Minos, king of Crete.
explanation.definitionFit: Myth makes Europa, abducted by Zeus, the mother of Minos, legendary ruler of Crete.

clue.text: Sit papers dealing with main god

parts.note: to sit for a portrait is to pose
ID, identity papers
on means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An instruction to sit an exam whose papers concern a principal deity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' is the old word for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea, and the main is a poetic name for the ocean.

clue.text: Wary bishop is hosting Democrat Eddy near Sicily

parts.note: chary means cautious

indicators.note: the bishop and the word is take in the party letter as guest

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A cautious churchman entertains a Democratic politician called Eddy who lives near Sicily.
explanation.walkthrough: Eddy looks like a man's name; it is a whirlpool. Hmm: 'hosting' puts D between B and IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Charybdis was the whirlpool of myth in the Strait of Messina, beside Sicily, opposite the monster Scylla.

clue.text: Film dog in colour, one interrupting service

indicators.note: the middle pieces break into the service letters

parts.note: RN, the Royal Navy, a fighting service
a tint is a colour
I, the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A movie dog shown in colour, one breaking into the service.
explanation.definitionFit: Rin Tin Tin was the German Shepherd film star of 1920s Hollywood.

clue.text: Lots of deities (female) face a setback

parts.note: read cryptically as set back, the word set written backwards

explanation.surface: Many goddesses meet with a reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setback' is read as two words: SET written back. The bracketed '(female)' looks like part of the definition but supplies F.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the three Fates spun, measured and cut each mortal's thread; one's fate is one's lot.

clue.text: English lad gathers new wood

indicators.note: the young man's word takes the new letter into its middle

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: An English boy collects fresh timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebony is the hard dark timber of a tropical tree.

clue.text: Barman tours clubs with a European bunch of boozers

indicators.note: goes around the letter for clubs

parts.note: the composer Bach, a man of musical bars
C, card suit

explanation.surface: A pub barman goes round clubs with a European pack of drinkers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barman' looks like a pub worker; it is a composer, a man of musical bars.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bacchae were the wine-crazed female followers of Bacchus, god of wine.

clue.text: Check claim involving northern dispute

parts.note: CH is the chess abbreviation for check

indicators.note: the claim word wraps around the northern letter

parts.note: to allege is to claim

explanation.surface: Verifying an assertion about something in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: To challenge a claim is to dispute it, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Cryptic clue about providing radical Morning Star

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go around the conditional word
cryptic means puzzling, reordering the letters

parts.note: if means providing that
R, abbreviation for radical

explanation.surface: A puzzle clue about supplying a left-wing daily paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Morning Star' looks like the British socialist newspaper, which fits 'radical'; it is the planet Venus. 'Cryptic' is the anagram signal for the word clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucifer is an old name for Venus seen as the morning star before dawn.

clue.text: Repulsive women try to cuddle up, hugging Romeo

indicators.note: the outer letters embrace the Romeo letter

parts.note: to have a go is to try

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to snog is to kiss and cuddle
R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Unattractive women attempt to snuggle up, embracing a Romeo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses the British slang snog in this down clue, and 'hugging' lets the outer pieces wrap the Romeo letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gorgons of Greek myth were hideous sisters whose look turned men to stone.

clue.text: Promise place on Fringe

parts.note: a fringe is an edge

explanation.surface: A vow to put on a show at the Edinburgh Fringe.
explanation.definitionFit: A pledge is a solemn undertaking or vow.

clue.text: Playwright succeeded with horror story

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
a chiller is a frightening tale

explanation.surface: A dramatist made a hit with a scary tale.
explanation.definitionFit: Friedrich Schiller was the German dramatist who wrote The Robbers and Mary Stuart.

clue.text: Old statesman exercised coercion on leaving

indicators.note: the remaining letters are worked over into a new order
the little word goes away from the longer one

explanation.surface: An elder statesman used coercion and then quit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on leaving' takes ON out of COERCION; 'exercised' rearranges the COERCI left over.
explanation.definitionFit: Cicero was the Roman orator and consul, a political figure of the ancient republic.

clue.text: Theban king about to rip off trousers

indicators.note: a verb here, pockets the other piece inside

parts.note: to con is to swindle
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A king of Thebes about to tear off his trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trousers' is a verb meaning pockets, not clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Creon ruled Thebes in Greek tragedy, uncle of Antigone in Sophocles.

clue.text: Star characters in Disney film

definitions.meaning: one of the seven little men belonging to Snow White in the Disney animation

explanation.surface: A celebrity appears among the cast of a Disney cartoon.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading treats White as Snow White's surname, so any of her seven companions is White's dwarf.
explanation.definitionFit: A white dwarf is a compact stellar remnant, while each of Snow White's companions is a dwarf of hers.

clue.text: Circus figure's painful back

indicators.note: the word for painful is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: sore means painful

explanation.surface: A circus performer suffers from a bad back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Circus' is London's Piccadilly Circus, a road junction whose famous statue is popularly called Eros, not a big top.
explanation.definitionFit: The winged statue atop the Shaftesbury Memorial fountain at Piccadilly Circus is popularly known as Eros.

clue.text: Ill-fated lover's articles, two of them foreign

parts.note: le is the French definite article, the first of three articles
an is the English indefinite article, the one of the three that is not foreign
der is the German definite article, a second foreign one

explanation.surface: Pieces written about a doomed lover, some of them from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole phrase 'articles, two of them foreign' gives three articles: LE (French), AN (English) and DER (German), two of the three being foreign.
explanation.definitionFit: Leander swam the Hellespont nightly to his beloved Hero and drowned in a storm.

clue.text: One who likes to scorn club first

parts.note: an iron is a golf club
1st, written IST

explanation.surface: Someone who enjoys mocking and puts the golf club first.
explanation.walkthrough: IST stands for 1ST with the figure one read as letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: An ironist uses irony, often mocking or scornful in tone.
